title: ork wait: do not fire again on a run whose question is answered and that only waits for a slot under the global cap

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
On 2026-11-26, after `ork answer ork-20261126-021911-97a7 ...` (S618) returned "resume waits for a slot; it starts before queued runs", the run showed "paused ... (wait: resume waits for a slot under global cap 4)". Every new `ork wait --project ork --until question,stopped,landed` and even `--until stopped,landed` then exited at once with "ork-20261126-021911-97a7 S618 question key: base-overlays.tracking-paths next: ork answer ...", although the question was answered. The orchestrator could only watch landings until a slot freed, which hides real stops and new questions.

ork wait should treat a run whose question is answered and that waits only for a slot as in progress, not as a question or a stop.
